page_title: Deployment of Altius UAS from NOAA WP-3D Orion N43RF on June 23, 2022 Courtesy Area I | Office of Marine and Aviation Operations
license: NOAA OMAO public release ('PUBLIC RELEASE' in file name); footage courtesy Area-I (contractor), so credit 'NOAA / Area-I'. Not plainly a U.S. government work: confirm before monetized use
contents: NOT a dropsonde. Belly camera on P-3 'Miss Piggy': an Altius-600 drone canister ejected from the aircraft's sonde launch tube tumbles away and unfolds. It is the closest NOAA/NASA-hosted footage to a 'dropsonde launch'; no actual dropsonde-release video was found on NOAA/NASA sites.
